name: Petty Cash Replenishment Request
description: Signed form listing individual receipts, account numbers and amounts, with remaining cash noted to verify the fund balance.
preparedBy: Person responsible for the petty cash fund
recipient: Director of Business Services or designee
quote: Replenishment of the petty cash fund shall be periodically requested through the Business Office on a form listing all individual receipts, the appropriate account number to charge and the amount.
